senses.gloss:
तम् तम्, cl. 4. P. (rarely A.) ताम्यति,
ताम्यते, तताम, तमितुम्, to gasp for
breath (as one suffocating), choke, be suffocated,
breathe with difficulty; to faint away; to be exhausted,
perish; to be distressed in body or mind; to be
disturbed or perplexed; to stop, become immovable
or stiff; to wish, desire: Caus. तमयति, -यितुम्,
to suffocate, deprive of breath; [cf. Lat. temere,
tabeo (?); Old Germ. damf; Russ. tomlju.]

1. तम, अस्, m. darkness &c., = तमस् in its
various meanings; also = तमाल; (आ), f. night, =
तमाल, Phyllanthus Emblica; (अम्), n. darkness,
gloom; the point of the foot.
—तमाह्वय (˚म-
आह्˚), a kind of plant, = तालीश-पत्त्र.

तम 2. तम (for 1. see under rt. तम्, col. 1),
a Taddhita affix, the termination of the superlative
degree, used also as an independent word in the
sense of इष्ट-तम, most desired, and sometimes
added adverbially in the form तमाम्; [cf. तार-
तम्य.]

ताम ताम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. तम्), an object of
terror; fault, defect, vice; anxiety, distress, desire.

तमक, अस्, m. oppression (of the chest), a kind
of asthma; [cf. प्र-तमक.]

तमका, f. = तमा, तमालका, ˚की, तमाली, त-
मालिनी, Phyllanthus Emblica.

तमत, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous, cupidinous, longing
or hankering after; wished, desired.
तमन, अम्, n. the becoming breathless.

तमस्, अस्, n. darkness, gloom; the darkness of
hell, hell itself or a peculiar division of hell; the
obscuration of the sun or moon in eclipses, darkness
personified as Rāhu or the ascending node; mental
darkness, illusion, error (constituting one of the five
[]
forms of अ-विद्या in the Sāṅkhya phil.), sin, sorrow;
(in the Sāṅkhya phil.) darkness or ignorance as one
of the three qualities or constituents of everything in
creation, the other two being सत्त्व and रजस्, see
गुण; as an inherent quality of nature तमस् is
heavy and obstructive, and predominates in earth
and water, whence they fall and tend downwards;
in living beings it is the cause of ignorance, illusion,
lust, anger, pride, sorrow, dulness, and stolidity;
(अस्), m., N. of a descendant of Gṛtsa-mada, a son
of Śravas and father of Pra-kāśa; N. of a son of
Pṛthu-śravas and father of Uśanas; [cf. Lith. tamsa,
‘darkness;’ tamsus, ‘obscure:’ Russ. temnyi, ‘dark;’
temno-ta, ‘darkness:’ Hib. teim, ‘dark, obscure;’
teimhen, ‘darkness;’ teimheal, ‘an eclipse, dark-
ness:’ Old Germ. demar: Old Sax. thim: Angl.
Sax. dim: Lat. tenebrœ?].
—तमः-प्रभा or
तम-प्रभा, f., or तम-प्रभ or तमः-
प्रभ, अस्, m. a hell, one of the lowermost di-
visions of the infernal regions.
—तमः-प्रवेश,
अस्, m. groping in the dark; mental perplexity or
aberration.
—तमः-स्थित, अम्, n. ‘situated in
darkness,’ N. of a hell, one of the lowest divisions
of hell.
—तमसा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, or तमस्-
कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, like darkness, black, gloomy.
—तमस्-काण्ड, अस्, m. or तमस्-तति, इस्, f. great
or spreading darkness.
—तमस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, hav-
ing darkness, dark, gloomy; (ती), f. night.
—तमस्-
विन्, ई, इनी, इ, dark, gloomy; (नी), f. night; turmeric.
—तमो-गा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. roaming in the dark-
ness, concealing himself in darkness, an epithet of
Śuṣṇa.
—तमो-गु, उस्, m. an epithet of Rāhu, the
personified ascending node, the causer of darkness.
—तमो-गुण, अस्, m. the quality of darkness or
ignorance; see above under तमस्.
—तमोगुणिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, having the quality of तमस् predominant
in the temperament, irascible, ignorant, proud, &c.
—तमो-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying darkness;
(अस्), m. the sun; the moon; fire; an epithet of
Viṣṇu; an epithet of Śiva; a Buddha.
—तमो-
ज्योतिस्, इस्, m. ‘light in darkness,’ a fire-fly.
—तमो-
दर्शन, bilious fever.
—तमो-नुद्, त्, त्, त्, dis-
persing darkness; (त्), m. a shining body; the sun;
the moon; fire; a lamp; light.
—तमो-नुद, अस्, आ,
अम्, dispersing darkness; (अस्), m. the sun; the moon.
—तमो-ऽन्तकृत् (˚मस्-अन्˚), त्, त्, त्, making an end
of darkness; (त्), m., N. of one of the attendants
of Skanda.
—तमो-ऽन्त्य (˚मस्-अन्˚), अस्, m. one
of the ten ways in which an eclipse may happen.
—तमो-ऽपह (˚मस्-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, removing
darkness physical or moral, illumining, enlightening;
(अस्), m. the sun; the moon; fire; a Buddha.
—तमो-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, dispersing darkness; (त्), m.
a fire-fly.
—तमो-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘become dark-
ness,’ dark, covered with darkness; ignorant.
—त-
मो-मणि, इस्, m. ‘the jewel of darkness,’ a kind of
gem; a fire-fly.
—तमो-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting
or composed of darkness, derived from it, covered
with it; (अस्), m. the mind enveloped with darkness,
vexation, anger, one of the five forms of अ-विद्या in
the Sāṅkhya phil.
—तमो-ऽरि (˚मस्-अरि), इस्, m.
the enemy of darkness, the sun.
—तमो-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, dark, gloomy; [cf. तमस्-वत्.]
—तमो-
विकार, अस्, m. disease, sickness, (as a modification
of the Guṇa तमस्.)
—तमो-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्,
obscured, clouded; overcome with or influenced by
rage, fear, &c., or any of the effects of the property
of darkness.
—तमो-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. rejoicing or
delighting in darkness; (Sāy.) growing in the dark-
ness, increasing by the darkness.
—तमो-हन्, आ,
-घ्नी, अ, Ved. striking down or dispersing darkness.
—तमो-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, removing darkness, illu-
minating; (अस्), m. the moon.

तमस, अस्, ई, अम्, dark-coloured; (अस्), m.
darkness; a well; (आ), f., N. of a river, the Tamasā
or Tonse, falling into the Ganges below Pratiṣṭhāna;
(अम्), n. darkness (at end of comp., cf. अन्ध-त्˚,
अव-त्˚, वि-त्˚, सन्-त्˚); a city.

तामस तामस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तमस्), dark,
of or belonging to darkness; affected by or apper-
taining to the third quality or that of darkness (vice,
ignorance, &c.); ignorant, vicious, malignant; relating
to Manu Tāmasa; (अस्), m. a malignant or mis-
chievous person, a villain, an incendiary; a snake;
an owl; N. of the fourth Manu; N. of one of the
attendants of Śiva; (ई), f. night; sleep; an epithet
of Durgā; N. of a river, = जटामांसी (in this sense
a wrong reading for तापसी); (अम्), n. darkness
[cf. अन्ध-तामस]; तामसी तनूस्, the form as-
sumed by the Deity for the destruction of the world;
तामसी शक्तिस्, the faculty of Tamas.
—तामस-
कीलक, अस्, m., N. of certain astronomical Ketus.
—तामस-गुण, अस्, m. the quality of darkness;
see गुण.
—तामस-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, (in the
Sāṅkhya phil.) one of the forms of अ-तुष्टि, dissatis-
faction.
—तामस-वन, अम्, n. ‘the dark wood,’
N. of a forest.

तमस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, at the end of an adj. comp.
= तमस्; [cf. निस्-तमस्क.]

तमाल, अस्, m., N. of a tree with a very dark bark
[]
(but white blossoms), Xanthochymus Pictorius; N.
of various other plants, = वरुण and कृष्ण-ख-
दिर; (अस्), m. the sectarial mark made with sandal
(or perhaps the juice of the Tamāla fruit) upon the
forehead; a sword, a scymitar or large sacrificial
knife; (ई), f., N. of several plants, = ताम्र-वल्ली;
Phyllanthus Emblica; also = वरुण; (अस्, अम्), m.
n. the bark of the bamboo; (अम्), n. the leaf of
the Laurus Cassia, = पत्त्रक = तमाल-पत्त्र.
—तमाल-पत्त्र, अम्, n. the leaf of the Xantho-
chymus Pictorius; the leaf of the Laurus Cassia, Mala-
bathron; a sectarial mark on the forehead; the tree
Xanthochymus Pictorius.
—तमालपत्त्र-चन्द-
न-गन्ध, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
तमाल तमाल. See col. 2.

तमालक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the tree Xanthochymus
Pictorius; the bark of a bamboo; (इका), f., N. of two
plants, = ताम्र-वल्ली and भूम्य्-आमली, Phyllanthus
Emblica; N. of a place, = ताम-लिप्त [cf. तमालिनी];
N. of a woman; (अम्), n. the leaf of the Laurus
Cassia; a sort of pot-herb, Marsilea Dentata.

तमिस्र, अम्, n. darkness, a dark night; darkness
of mind, illusion; anger, wrath; (आ), f. a dark night,
or one during the wane of the moon; great or ex-
tensive darkness, the night of new moon, any night;
(अस्), m. the dark half of the month, from the full
to the change; [cf. सु-तमिस्र, तामिस्र, तमि-
षीचि.]
—तमिस्र-पक्ष, अस्, m. the fortnight of
the moon's wane, the time from full moon to new
moon.
तमिस्र तमिस्र. See above.

तामिस्र तामिस्र (fr. तमिस्र), scil. पक्ष,
the dark half of the month, the time from full moon
to new moon; (अस्), m. a Rākṣasa (as going about
in the dark); indignation at being disappointed or
slighted, anger, one of the five forms of Avidyā in
the Sāṅkhya system; a division of hell, that of
deep gloom.
तमङ्ग तमङ्ग, अस्, m. a platform, stage.

तमङ्गक, अस्, m. the flat and projecting roof
of a house, a sort of balcony or terrace.
तमर तमर, अम्, n. tin; lead (?).

तामर तामर, अम्, n. water; ghee or
oiled butter.
तमराज तमराज, अस्, m. a kind of sugar.
तमाह्वय तमाह्वय. See 1. तम, col. 1.

तमि तमि, इस्, or तमी, f. the night; tur-
meric; [cf. 1. तम and तमस्.]

तामि तामि, इस् or ई, f. (fr. rt. तम्), restrain-
ing or keeping in the breath until it produces ex-
haustion; (also said to = तमी, night.)

तमिषीचि तमिषीचि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. तम् ?),
Ved. oppressing, stunning, afflicting, confusing, dis-
turbing; (Sāy.) powerful, strong.

तमुष्टुहीय तमुष्टुहीय, अस्, आ, अम्, N. of a
Sūkta beginning with the words तम् उ ष्टुहि.

तमोलिप्ती तमोलिप्ती, f., N. of a country,
the district of Tumlook in Bengal, = ताम-लिप्त,
commonly called तमोलुक.
तम्पा तम्पा, f. a cow; [cf. तम्बा.]
तम्ब् तम्ब्, cl. 1. P. तम्बति, &c., to go.
तम्बा तम्बा, f. a cow; [cf. तम्पा.]

तम्बीर तम्बीर or तम्वीर, in astrology
تمْوير the fourteenth Yoga.

तम्र तम्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तम्), Ved.
oppressing, darkening; (Sāy.) causing to languish.

ताम्र ताम्र, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
तम्), of a coppery red colour, (ताम्रा त्वच्, the
[]
fourth of the seven skins or membranes with which an
embryo is covered); (अस्), m. a kind of leprosy with
large red spots; N. of a man [cf. ताम्रायण]; N.
of an island [cf. ताम्र-द्वीप]; (आ), f., N. of several
plants, viz. = मञ्जिष्ठा, Rubia Munjista, = रक्त-
गुञ्जा, Abrus Precatorius, = सैंहली; N. of a
daughter of Dakṣa, one of the wives of Kaśyapa,
and mother of various birds; N. of a river; (अम्),
n. a dark or coppery red; copper; a kind of sandal,
represented as of a dark-red colour and smelling like
a lotus; Ved. form, figure; (अस्, ई, अम्), made of
copper; (ई), f. a copper or metallic cup of prescribed
capacity and perforated by a small hole at the bottom,
(when placed in a vessel of water it answers the
purpose of a clepsydra, and the water gradually filling
it marks the time that has elapsed); [cf. Hib. umha,
‘copper.’]
—ताम्र-कण्टक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
a kind of Acacia.
—ताम्र-कर्णी, f., N. of the
female of one of the elephants of the quarters called
Añjana; also of the elephant Śeṣa.
—ताम्र-कार,
अस्, m. a brazier, a copper-smith.
—ताम्र-किलि, इस्,
m. a small worm of a red colour; [cf. ताम्र-कृमि.]
—ताम्र-कुट्ट, अस्, ई, m. f. a brazier or copper-
smith.
—ताम्र-कुट्टक, अस्, m. = the last; tobacco (?).
—ताम्र-कुण्ड, अम्, n. a copper bason or other
vessel; probably N. of a place.
—ताम्र-कूट, अस्,
अम्, m. n. a kind of plant, tobacco (?).
—ताम्र-
कृमि, इस्, m. the lady-bird; cochineal.
—ताम्र-
गर्भ, अम्, n. blue vitriol or sulphate of copper.
—ताम्र-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. a kind of pigeon.
—ताम्र-चूड, अस्, आ, अम्, red-crested; (अस्),
m. a cock [cf. ताम्र-शिखिन्]; a kind of plant
(कुक्कुर-द्रु); a particular position of the hand
[cf. ताम्रचूडक]; N. of a Pari-vrājaka; (आ),
f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
—ताम्रचूडक, अस्, m. (scil. हस्त), a kind of
theatrical gesticulation or motion of the hands.
—ताम्रचूड-भैरव, अस्, m. a peculiar form of
Bhairava.
—ताम्रचूडादि-कथन (˚ड-आद्˚), अम्,
n. ‘explanation of the Tāmra-cūḍa gesticulation
&c.,’ N. of a section of the Mantra-mahodadhi by
Mahī-dhara.
—ताम्रजाक्ष (˚ज-अक्˚), अस्, m., N.
of a son of Kṛṣṇa and Satya-bhāmā.
—ताम्र-
तनु, उस्, उस्, उ, having a ruddy or fair complexion,
copper-coloured.
—ताम्र-तुण्ड, अस्, m. a sort of
monkey.
—ताम्र-त्रपुज, brass.
—ताम्र-त्व,
अम्, n. dark-red or copper colour, redness.
—ताम्र-
दुग्धा, f. a species of plant, = गोरक्ष-दुग्धा.
—ताम्र-द्रु, उस्, m. red sandal-wood.
—ताम्र-
द्वीप, अस्, m. the island Ceylon.
—ताम्र-धातु,
उस्, m. red chalk.
—ताम्र-धूम्र, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. dark-red, coppery red.
—ताम्र-ध्वज, अस्,
m., N. of a man.
—ताम्र-नेत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, red-
eyed.
—ताम्र-पक्षा, f., N. of a daughter of
Kṛṣṇa.
—ताम्र-पक्षिन्, ई, m., N. of a son of
Kṛṣṇa.
—ताम्र-पट्ट, अस्, m. a copper plate on
which Hindū grants of land &c. are frequently in-
scribed; [cf. ताम्र-शासन.]
—ताम्र-पत्त्र,
अम्, n. a copper plate; (अस्), m. a kind of pot-herb,
= जीव-शाक.
—ताम्र-पत्त्रक, N. of the two
plants Bauhinia Tomentosa and Capparis Aphylla.
—ताम्र-पर्ण, अम्, n., N. of a district renowned
for a temple of Śiva, the ancient Taprobane; Ceylon;
(ई), f. the plant Rubia Munjista (मञ्जिष्ठा);
a kind of pond or lake; N. of a river rising in
Malaya and of the district in its vicinity, (the river is
celebrated for its pearls); N. of a town in Ceylon,
after which the whole island is by some called
Tāmra-parṇī; [cf. ताम्र-द्वीप.]
—ताम्रपर्-
णीय, अस्, m. (fr. the last), an inhabitant of Ceylon,
especially a Buddhist.
—ताम्र-पल्लव, अस्, m. the
Aśoka tree.
—ताम्र-पाकिन्, ई, m. the tree Thes-
pesia Populneoides and Hibiscus Populneoides.
—ता-
म्र-पात्र, अम्, n. a copper vessel.
—ताम्र-पादी,
f. a kind of plant related to the Mimosa Pudica,
= हंस-पदी.
—ताम्र-पुष्प, अम्, n. a copper-
coloured or red flower; (अस्), m. the plant Bauhinia
Variegata or a kind of ebony (रक्त-काञ्चन);
another plant, Kæmpferia Rotunda (भूमि-चम्-
पक); (ई), f., N. of several plants having red
flowers, viz. Bignonia Suaveolens, Grislea Tomentosa,
[]
Ipomœa Turpethum (त्रि-वृत्); [cf. ताम्र-पुष्-
पिका.]
—ताम्र-पुष्पक, अस्, m. Bauhinia Varie-
gata or a kind of ebony; (इका), f., N. of several
plants, viz. = Bignonia Suaveolens, Grislea Tomentosa,
also = Marāthī रक्त-निशोत्तरा.
—ताम्र-फल,
अस्, m. the tree Alangium Hexapetalum.
—ताम्र-
फलक, अम्, n. a copper plate.
—ताम्र-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of copper, coppery.
—ताम्र-
मारण, अम्, n. the decomposition of copper and
its application as a remedy.
—ताम्र-मुख, अस्, ई,
अम्, copper-faced, fair-complexioned; (अस्), m. a
European.
—ताम्र-मूला and ई, f., N. of several
plants, Rubia Munjista, Alhagi Maurorum, Mimosa
Pudica.
—ताम्र-मृग, अस्, m. the red deer.
—ताम्र-रसायनी, f. a species of plant with a
milky juice, = ताम्र-दुग्धा.
—ताम्र-लिप्त, आस्,
m. pl., N. of a people near the western mouth of
the Ganges; (अस्), m., N. of a Ṛṣi; (आ or ई), f.,
N. of the capital of the Tāmra-liptas; [cf. ताम-
लिप्ती.]
—ताम्रलिप्तक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people
near the western mouth of the Ganges; (इका), f.,
N. of the capital of this people, = ताम्र-लिप्ता.
—ताम्र-वर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, copper-coloured, dark-
red; (अस्), m. a kind of grass, = पल्लिवाह; N. of
one of the nine divisions of Bhārata-varṣa; (आ), f.
the China rose; (ई), f. the blossom of sesamum.
—ताम्र-वर्णक, अस्, m. = ताम्र-वर्ण.
—ता-
म्र-वल्ली, f. the plant Rubia Munjista; a medi-
cinal plant used as an emollient in affections of
the mouth and fauces; also called तमाली, ताली,
सूक्ष्म-वल्ली, &c.
—ताम्र-वीज, अस्, m. a kind
of vetch, Dolichos Uniflorus (कुलत्थ).
—ताम्र-
वृक्ष, अस्, m. the plant Dolichos Uniflorus; a red
sort of sandal-wood.
—ताम्र-वृन्त, अस्, m. the plant
Dolichos Uniflorus; (आ), f. another kind of Dolichos.
—ताम्र-शाटीय, आस्, m. pl. ‘having red vestments,’
N. of a Buddhist school.
—ताम्र-शासन, अम्, n.

ताम्बूल ताम्बूल, अम्, ई, n. f. (said to be fr.
rt. तम्), betel, Piper Betel, or rather its pungent
and aromatic leaf, which together with the areca-nut
and catechu and sometimes caustic lime and spices
is eaten or chewed very generally by the natives of
the east, acting as a carminative and antacid tonic.
It is called Pān (fr. पर्ण, ‘a leaf,’ the name
betel being connected with वीटिका, q. v.), and is pre-
sented to guests and visitors, and sometimes sent to
relations and friends at family festivals, inclosed in
gold or silver paper; (अम्), n. the areca-nut; (अस्),
m. Bengal Śaṇa or Crotolaria Juncea.
